Alice Tran: Quick heads-up — Aurora reserved pool onboarding TOMORROW 09:00 PT. Final prep for quota + autoscale smoke tests. Need runbook owner, warmup window, and who runs the load scripts. @Marcus Lee @Priya Shah
Priya Shah: I can run the load scripts. They want 2k steady QPS with 4k bursts for 10m. Do we have an agreed model variant and sequence length for profiling? :thinking_face:
Marcus Lee: Model pinned to redwood/gpt-large-v2@v3 (32k). Our perf numbers at 1k seq: ~110 rps/GPU. Current reserved pool = 6 GPUs (A10G). Autoscale config: min_replicas=3 max_replicas=12 policy=rps target=250
Alice Tran: @Marcus that target sounds low vs requested QPS. Can you re-check capacity calc vs their expected concurrency? We need a clear quota number for customer commit.
Marcus Lee: Quick calc: 2k steady / 250 rps = 8 replicas needed steady. Add headroom for bursts (4k) => ~16 replicas peak; since max_replicas=12 we'll either need more GPUs or higher per-replica throughput via batching/quant.
Evan Gomez: For tomorrow can we: (1) increase max_replicas to 20 temporarily, (2) schedule warmup script 09:10–09:25 PT to populate KV cache, (3) have fallback to shared-hosted if queue depth > 600? I updated the runbook draft.
Priya Shah: Sounds good. I have a k6 script ready. Quick run command I'll use for smoke:
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m script.js --env TARGET_URL=https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
I'll also run a ramp to 4k QPS with vegeta if we need spike testing:
```
echo "GET https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" | vegeta attack -rate=4000 -duration=5m | vegeta report
```
capacity-bot: reserved-pool/aurora status check: nodes=6/6, gpus_ok=true, mem_util=42%, recent_errors=0
deploy-bot: loadtest-runner: scheduled loadtest for 2025-03-26T16:15:00Z by Priya Shah
Alice Tran: OK all — plan for tomorrow: warmup 09:10 PT, smoke at 09:15 (k6 steady), full burst ramp at 09:30 (vegeta). @Evan will monitor runbook triggers, @Marcus please bump max_replicas to 20 pre-test. Post results here after smoke. :rocket:
Priya Shah: Copy that. I'll post perf logs and per-replica latency percentiles in thread.
Marcus Lee: I bumped max_replicas to 20 and added autoscale override for test window. Also uploaded the new capacity calc to the onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/aurora-capacity
Alice Tran: Thanks — appreciate it. If anything unexpected ping me directly. We'll include renewal-risk note in the customer health tracker if we miss SLA during test.
